name: Product marketing manager
summary: Decides how a product is positioned, what it says and how it launches. Writes the message sheet and launch plan the rest of the team works from.

changelog.note: First release: positioning canon, message sheets, rival maps, launch tiers and handoffs, pricing pages, and US, UK and EU rules on comparative, savings and price claims (FTC, CAP Code and ASA rulings, CMA, EU), with 25 checked sources. Naming a competitor in public needs a fresh yes.
